name: jsonata
description: Evaluate a JSONata expression against a JSON document. Two arities: 2-arg `jsonata(expr, json)` and 3-arg `jsonata(expr, json, bindings)` for passing extra named values into the expression scope.

examples.code: SELECT jsonata('{ "name": FirstName & " " & Surname, "mobile": Phone[type="mobile"].number }', payload) FROM contacts;
